# Vincent Mugondora

> Zimbabwean software developer, AI builder, educator, and entrepreneur based in Harare, Zimbabwe. Building practical technology, teaching programming, and creating AI solutions for businesses in Africa.

## About

Vincent Mugondora builds software, AI agents, and automation tools for businesses in Zimbabwe and across Africa. He is the founder of Zimnovate and teaches developers how to build with modern technology.

- [About Vincent](https://vincentmugondora.com/about): Full biography, career timeline, and engineering philosophy
- [Full content for AI](https://vincentmugondora.com/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive content for citation and reference

## Services

- [Software Development](https://vincentmugondora.com/services/software-development): Custom full-stack applications, APIs, and system architecture
- [Web Development](https://vincentmugondora.com/services/web-development): Fast, accessible websites optimized for African internet conditions
- [AI Solutions](https://vincentmugondora.com/services/ai-solutions): AI chatbots, agents, RAG systems, and custom AI integration for businesses
- [AI Automation](https://vincentmugondora.com/services/ai-automation): Workflow automation, document processing, and WhatsApp automation
